mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO sys_notify_user_message (message_id, user_id, create_by, create_time) VALUES
(#{item.messageId}, #{item.userId}, #{item.createBy}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_notify_user_message WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND read_flag = 0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_notify_user_message WHERE read_flag = 1 AND read_time < #{cutoff}
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, SUM(read_flag = 0) AS unread_count, IFNULL(MAX(id), 0) AS last_receipt_id FROM sys_notify_user_message GROUP BY user_id
